title: Kimi K3 Just Shocked the AI Industry 🤯 Better Than GPT-5?
description:
🚨 Kimi 3 is here, and it could be one of the biggest AI releases of the year.

Moonshot AI has unveiled Kimi 3, a powerful open AI model that's already turning heads with its coding, UI generation, reasoning, and long-context capabilities.

🔥 Developers have already used it to:

Build a CS:GO-style portal game
Create an Animal Crossing-inspired game
Generate a complete macOS-inspired UI with smooth animations

💰 The biggest surprise? It delivers impressive performance while costing significantly less than many leading proprietary AI models, making advanced AI development more accessible than ever.

While GPT-5 and other frontier models still lead in some benchmarks, Kimi 3 is closing the gap faster than many expected.

👇 Would you choose Kimi 3 or GPT-5? Let me know in the comments!
